methodology:
AgroGeneration is a tiny French-listed Ukrainian operator with cultivated area in Eastern Ukraine (Kharkiv/Sumy regions, frontline-adjacent). The vast majority of the 28,500 cultivated hectares are LEASED, not owned — so the property table greatly overstates owned land relative to balance-sheet book.

2024 revenue of €22.6M with €5.7M operating EBITDA (excluding war-related expenses); net debt €0.6M. Deep wartime discount is appropriate given frontline geography.

Acres shown reflect cultivated area for cluster-level FMV purposes; only ~€3M of the €11M total equity is fixed-asset land book. The implied NAV doesn't mean much for ALAGR — equity value is dominated by working capital, biological assets, and ongoing-business value.
